scope: Named scientific development units; automated tests are separate checks, not added to scientific denominators.

feature_construction_counts.optimizer_note: Optimizer evaluations reuse constructed arrays; optimizer function-call counts were not retained and are not episode replays.

resources_whole_fit_run.cpu_measurement_status: Not retained by corpus collector or fit driver; unmeasured, not zero.
resources_whole_fit_run.scope: Elapsed run includes corpus collection, feature construction, three frozen fits and 288 online-rate prediction replay passes. No component-level fit/replay CPU or wall split was retained.

comparator_fitting_corpus.uniqueness_note: 264 indexed world episode records, 215 distinct observed action/observation traces. Shared initial conditions across regimes can produce identical observed experience; this does not reduce actual execution counts.

resources_whole_diagnostic_run.scope: Combined 72 world episodes, 72 new known-law in-process prediction passes, and 12 frame-level freeze-audit passes. Loading 144 saved prediction rows is not rerunning them; component-level replay costs were not retained.

non_test_smoke.description: One initial.py switching case and three-regime native evaluator smoke; not search slots.

matched_fitting_subvalidation.scope: Selection-biased development: initial prior and online rate selected on this subvalidation. Rate0 is frozen; rates0.5,2,8 are online.

search: Use search-summary.json and native-audit.json for exact ongoing counts.

matched_predictor_smoke.pool: eight development switching cases under original memory policy

shadow_resources.scope: Shadow replay only; excludes policy world generation.

matched_driver_integration_smoke.pool: one development switching case under original memory policy

shadow_resources.scope: Shadow replay only; excludes policy world generation.

gen1_mechanism_smoke.scope: interface and source-specific risk smoke; not champion selection or final assessment

count_semantics.condition_episodes: Executed world episodes, including repeated executions of the same case. Replaying saved observations adds zero world episodes.
count_semantics.in_process_prediction_episode_passes: One predictor reset followed by one recorded episode in the analysis process; terminal transitions excluded in fitting/diagnostic replay because no subsequent observation is recorded.
count_semantics.in_process_feature_construction_episode_: One recorded episode traversed to construct immutable fitting arrays; kept separate from prediction comparison passes.
count_semantics.isolated_shadow_episode_passes: One isolated predictor process over one recorded policy episode. Matched smoke includes terminal transitions and keeps its costs separate.
count_semantics.reported_prediction_records: Saved result rows; reused rows do not imply another execution.
count_semantics.unique_recorded_experience: Episode records are indexed by layout and regime. Distinct observable trajectories are separately counted by hashing recorded observations/actions; paired regimes can share identical experience and are not independent replicates.

comparator_matched_diagnostic_replays.known_law_reference_note: Constructs trusted environment objects to recover current probabilities; does not execute world transitions or generate another trajectory.
comparator_matched_diagnostic_replays.resource_accounting: Included in comparator_decision_diagnostic.resources_whole_diagnostic_run; no separately measured replay cost.

completed_comparator_replay_accounting.scope: Completed fitting, comparator diagnostic, eight-case isolated matched smoke and one-case isolated integration smoke; excludes later selected-program work and automated tests.
completed_comparator_replay_accounting.isolated_smoke_unique_note: Integration reran smoke case0: one additional policy world execution and three shadow passes, but an identical verified policy trajectory hash.
completed_comparator_replay_accounting.in_process_unique_note: 72 indexed subvalidation episode records contain 58 distinct observation/action trace hashes. Private fitting corpus omits hidden world state, so this is observable-experience uniqueness; regime pairing does not create independent replicates.
completed_comparator_replay_accounting.feature_construction_scope: The original v3_fit.py array-construction passes; subsequent array inspection or optimizer vector operations are not prediction comparison episodes.
